design_review.single_changed_variable: product-only scope-aware typed current-preference write and same-scope supersession for P4-H-selected multilingual explicit self-reports
design_review.reason: The passing P4-H execution preserved both utterances as episodes but left English and new Chinese current values absent from typed likes, so a truthful memory acknowledgement still lacks complete typed current-preference semantics.

implementation_requirements: reuse the frozen P4-H classifier as the activation gate without changing P4-H plan or surface behavior
extract exactly one explicit current positive value and for corrections one distinct explicitly negated old value
derive an explicit preference scope when stated and otherwise use general; inherit a unique matching active old scope during correction
write a new typed positive record with a scope-specific single-value predicate
write a negative old-value record only for an explicit correction negation
preserve prior records and let deterministic validity resolution classify older same-scope positives as historical
attach scalar source language input digest act scope classifier cue epistemic and temporal provenance
update the in-session profile consistently while keeping persistent profile shadow out of answer generation
materialize one raw-dialogue-free memory-stage node in the runtime graph
delegate all non-selected or ambiguous inputs to the unchanged existing profile writer
verification_order: run this frozen contract and immutable-before binding test
implement only the authorized adapter test and product-entry files
run exact three-language parser writer supersession scope-isolation and negative-delegation tests
run affected V68 V69 P4-F P4-G and P4-H regressions
import the product entry and verify the product-only writer snapshot and graph wrappers are installed
commit and push the implementation before freezing any new cross-restart real case
claim_boundary: P4-I offline success would establish only a bounded product typed-state mechanism for explicit current preferences. It cannot establish cross-restart conversational recall, full runtime or Safari behavior, open-world understanding, human-like memory, user preference, LLM superiority or a human equation.
